Joe: Hey, Sion! Wake up!! Something terrible's happened!
Sion: Mm... Uncle Joe? What's the matter?
Joe: What do you mean, what's the matter?! The girl's gone missing!!
Sion: What?!
Welda: Tch. Now we're in trouble. Read this.
[Letter]
To our friends in Chausnomyu,
Welcome to Zajil.
All your noisy activities have become quite a nuisance, so we've taken the young lady into our care.
There are a few things we'd very much like to discuss. Please come to the town of Porkin.
If you care about the girl, don't try anything foolish.
[End of letter]
Sion: Sh-Shoko's been kidnapped?!
Welda: That's about the size of it.
Joe: No choice, then. Looks like we'll have to go to Porkin.
